claims: BKNG) completed a 25-for-1 forward stock split on April 2, 2026.
Shareholders received 25 shares for every one held in the Booking Holdings stock split.
Booking Holdings stock price reduced from over $4,000 to around $170 due to the stock split.
The effective date of the Booking Holdings stock split was after hours on April 2, 2026.
The shareholder record date for the Booking Holdings stock split was March 6, 2026.
The purpose of the Booking Holdings stock split was to lower the high nominal share price of ∼$4,000+ and improve liquidity.
Authorized common shares of Booking Holdings increased from 1 billion to 25 billion.
The Booking Holdings stock split does not change the underlying fundamentals, valuation, or company market cap.
For every one share held before the Booking Holdings stock split, an investor held 25 shares afterward.
Each share after the Booking Holdings stock split was valued at 1/25th of the pre-split price.
